title: Singleton normalization of the geometric bounded coefficient coordinates
statement: For every prime ell, algebraically closed field K, and bounded algebraic ell-adic function a on the singleton profinite object S, the specified point-adjunction unit sends a to restriction along the structural map q_K of fieldCoefficientIso(K,ell) inverse applied to the value of a at the singleton point.

source.place: Section 4, finite-matrix refinement: presentation and geometric-fibre comparison after coefficient realization (steps 1--3)

proof.text: Construct constant bounded functions using the finite intermediate field generated by a scalar. The terminal coefficient inverse has value the sheafification unit on the corresponding constant function, by the definition of fieldCoefficientIso and cancellation of fieldUnitIso and boundedPointIso.
Apply globalCoefficientIso_test and naturality of the global realization and bounded-presheaf unit along q_K. Pullback preserves the constant value. Cancel the evaluated realization isomorphism.
Every function on the singleton is constant. Replace the constant function by the given a using subsingleton extensionality.

theorem condensedQbar_field_point_coefficient_value (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    (a : PadicAlgCl.finiteIntermediateFieldValued ℓ
      (Profinite.of (ULift.{u, 0} PUnit.{1}))) :
    let X := Spec (.of K)
    let A := condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) X
    let S := Profinite.of (ULift.{u, 0} PUnit.{1})
    (((geometricFieldAbelianPointAdjunction X).unit.app
      (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ)).hom.app (op S)).hom (ULift.up a) =
    (A.obj.map (geometricFieldTestFinalMap X).op).hom
      ((inv (CondensedQbarGeometricEvaluation.fieldCoefficientIso K ℓ).hom.hom).hom
        (ULift.up (a.1 default)))
